name: Lasgun Laser — Beam Diagnostic
author: crystal-mods
description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — changes no visuals. A BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) plugin that logs each lasgun shot's projectile effect (name, start = muzzle position, end = target, trajectory) so the red laser-beam mod can be built on verified data. Requires the BepInEx runtime (shipped with the Traditional Chinese Localization mod) to be installed. Grep BepInEx/LogOutput.log for '[LASBEAM]'.
requires: BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) runtime — the BepInEx Framework mod
notes: Remove LasBeamDiag.dll from BepInEx/plugins/ (or disable in Vortex) after collecting the log.
